item.chikem-mod.golchick_food.tooltip.ab: Feed to two adult chickens, then watch for the hearts — a Special Chickem hatches by the difficulty odds below.
item.chikem-mod.golchick_food.tooltip.sp: Spawn chance: Peaceful 30% | Easy 24% | Normal 18% | Hard 14% | Hardcore 12%
item.chikem-mod.golchick_food.tooltip.lo: Treasure sources: structure chests 35%, fishing treasure 8% per treasure roll (5% vanilla weight, so effective per-catch is lower).
item.chikem-mod.golchick_food.tooltip.fl: Sun-warmed wheat, sung to by the flock.
item.chikem-mod.goldie_egg.tooltip.abili: Throwable egg. It hatches a RANDOM Special Chickem (Swiftwing/Dashclaw/Featherfall/Lucky Beak).
item.chikem-mod.goldie_egg.tooltip.loot_: Treasure chance: structure chests 12% | fishing treasure 3% per treasure roll (5% vanilla weight, so effective per-catch is lower)
Found in dungeons, temples, strongholds, ancient cities, end cities, bastions.
entity.chikem-mod.mountable_chicken.spee: Hatched from an egg that rolled into a lightning scar during a mesa storm, Swiftwing learned to read the wind before it could walk. It does not run — it chases weather, ferrying swift seeds to barren soil and scouting clear skies for the flock. Ability: fastest mount in the flock. Drawback: fragile — one less heart than a normal chicken.
entity.chikem-mod.mountable_chicken.dash: Born in a fox-raided coop, Dashclaw survived by striking first and vanishing. Its golden leg feathers are scar tissue from the night it escaped. It asks no fight — only distance. Ability: recharging dash burst. Drawback: brief slowdown after each dash.
entity.chikem-mod.mountable_chicken.slow: An ancient city's last chick, found sleeping in a clean chest guarded by a sculk warden who never woke her. She learned that the safest way down is to be too quiet to notice. Ability: fall-damage immune, glides while falling. Drawback: slow on ground and in air.
entity.chikem-mod.mountable_chicken.luck: The only chick ever hatched inside a treasure chest, Lucky Beak carries a dull gold nugget in her beak that she swears is a soul-gem. It isn't. But fortune seems to loiter near her anyway. Ability: golden aura blessing nearby players with Luck. Drawback: blesses only travelers within sight.
